title: values completely off
symptom: After switching from blucon to miao miao and using a Libra sensor with the nightly version from July 7th of Xdrip, readings are way off compared to finger pricking, sometimes 40 units difference, which never happened before.
cause: The calibration chart shows significant variance between finger stick tests and raw value, possibly indicating a noisy sensor.
fix: Enable Datricsae calibration plugin from advanced calibration, which uses a different weighting mechanism. Also, calibrate only if the value is off and use finger-stick value entry via the treatment editor and automated calibration.
evidence_quote: You can try enabling Datricsae calibration plugin from advanced calibration and see if that produces better results. It uses a different weighting mechanism.
